# cpanel_modsecurity_domain (Resource)

Manages the ModSecurity status for an existing domain in a cPanel account. Removing the resource re-enables ModSecurity and preserves the domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_modsecurity_domain" "website" {
  domain  = "www.example.com"
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The existing account domain to manage.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether ModSecurity must be enabled for the domain.

### Read-Only

- `affected_domains` (Set of String) The managed domain and every related domain that cPanel reports as affected.
- `dependencies` (Set of String) Related domains that cPanel reports as affected by changes to this domain.
- `domain_type` (String) The cPanel domain type: `main` or `sub`.
- `search_hint` (String) The search hint reported by cPanel for related domains.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_modsecurity_domain.website www.example.com
```
